The browser loads only network filters. It does not load EasyPrivacy,
regional lists, externally referenced subscriptions, cosmetic filters,
scriptlets, redirect resources or CSP injection rules. This is not full
uBlock Origin compatibility or a guarantee that every advertisement is blocked.
Runtime serialization changes the storage format, not the filter source.
Keep this attribution and license with redistributed source or cached filters.
The filter license does not replace the licenses of independent browser code.

Update policy

Filters are bundled, hash-checked and cached locally per persistent profile.
There is no automatic download, remote update check, telemetry, subscription
endpoint or user-supplied filter URL. The list's upstream Expires comment is
not a runtime download schedule. The reload action rebuilds the cache from
this release's checked list. It does not fetch a newer list or reload a page.

To update, review a new upstream EasyList snapshot and its license, replace
assets/blocking/easylist.txt, update FILTER_VERSION and FILTER_SHA256 in
browser/src/blocking/profile.ts, and update this notice. Exercise blocking,
site exceptions and the file-XHR guard before distributing the new release.
The list and engine versions form the cache key, so a reviewed release update
cannot silently reuse a previous release's compiled filters. Old caches are
not deleted automatically. Existing profile enable/disable and exact-host
exceptions remain in settings.json. There is no background update commitment.
